# guardium-data-protection_k3s_cluster (Resource)

Installs and manages a K3S cluster on remote nodes via SSH. Supports single-node and multi-node deployments.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the K3S cluster
- `master_nodes` (List of String) List of master node hostnames (FQDNs)

### Optional

- `airgap_install` (Boolean) Airgap installation
- `airgap_installation_path` (String) The Path of K3s installation binary saved
- `delete_timeout` (String) Timeout for the delete operation (e.g. '2h', '90m'). Default: 2h.
- `disable_traefik` (Boolean) Disable Traefik ingress controller
- `k3s_token` (String, Sensitive) Token for K3S cluster authentication
- `k3s_version` (String) K3S version to install (e.g., v1.32.3)
- `node_wait_timeout` (String) Timeout for node readiness check (e.g., 600s)
- `taint_masters` (Boolean) Taint master nodes to prevent workload scheduling (multi-node only)
- `worker_nodes` (List of String) List of worker node hostnames (FQDNs). Empty for single-node cluster.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_type` (String) Cluster deployment type: single-node or multi-node
- `id` (String) Resource identifier (cluster name)
- `kubeconfig_path` (String) Path to kubeconfig on the primary master node
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of last update
- `primary_master` (String) Primary master node hostname (first master node)
